title: Code and results for: Delayed calibration of panel quantile forecasts after structural breaks: a pre-specified evaluation on food prices in six countries
description: Replication code, the pre-specified evaluation protocol and derived results for the paper submitted to the Journal of Applied Statistics. The source data (NBS Selected Food Price Watch, World Bank Real-Time Food Prices, ACLED) are public and are not redistributed; the README explains how to obtain them.
